title: China Sanctions Skydio, the Largest US-Based Drone Maker
description: China issued sanctions against drone maker Skydio, the largest drone maker in the US, because it sells its products to Taiwan.

title: China sanctions US drone maker Skydio in ongoing trade war
description: China has sanctioned Skydio, America’s largest drone maker, for providing unmanned aerial vehicles to Taiwan’s national fire service

title: "A very discourteous fellow." Intel's CEO made comments that blew a huge discount deal on TSMC chips, wiping the firm's profit margins according to this damning report.
description: According to Reuters, Intel CEO Pat Gelsinger's offhanded comments about Taiwan's relationship with China cost the flagging chip maker millions in wafer discounts from TSMC.

title: Shanghai Prepares for Historic Rains as Typhoon Kong-rey Approaches
description: Shanghai braces for severe rains not seen in over 40 years as Typhoon Kong-rey approaches. Train suspensions and warnings have been issued. Expected to hit Taiwan first as a category 4 storm, the typhoon is set to bring extreme weather to China's eastern coast.

title: FirstUp: PM Modi in Gujarat, Typhoon Kong-rey to hit Taiwan... Big headlines today
description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi will launch several projects worth Rs 284 crore on the birth anniversary of Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel at the Statue of Unity in Gujarat. Meanwhile, Taiwan is bracing for super typhoon Kong-rey. Slovak PM Robert Fico will begin his visit China to foster closer bilateral and economic ties

title: Taiwan Braces for Super Typhoon Kong-rey: Largest Storm in 30 Years Looms
description: Taiwan has preemptively shut down as Super Typhoon Kong-rey approaches, with forecasts predicting it to be the largest storm in 30 years. Strong winds and heavy rainfall are expected, prompting evacuations and military readiness. The storm is set to impact eastern Taiwan's coast before weakening and moving toward China.

title: After Trump Calls for Protection Fee, China Says US Could 'Abandon' Taiwan
description: China's Taiwan Affairs Office denounced the $2 billion arms sale the U.S. announced for Taiwan last week.

title: The far-flung Japanese island that could find itself on the front lines of a China-Taiwan conflict
description: Japan has increased defence spending in recent years amid Tokyo’s growing anxiety over Beijing and fears of conflict over Taiwan

title: China's Xi pressed Biden to alter language on Taiwan
description: Washington/Beijing/Taipei: Chinese President Xi Jinping asked U.S. President Joe Biden last year to change the language the United States uses when discussing its position on Taiwanese independence,...

title: Unbeaten Canada survives tough test from China at Pan Continental championships
description: LACOMBE, Alta. — Canada's Rachel Homan improved to 3-0 at the Pan Continental Curling Championships with a 13-0 rout of Taiwan in Monday's early draw and a tough 7-5 victory over China in the evening draw.
